blocks.text:
Flipbook changes the way Home pages move while you swipe: Cube, Inside Cube, Carousel and Stack are built into Folio. You choose the look in Settings › Tweaks › Flipbook. Additional effects, including Tilt, can be installed independently from this source.

While you drag an app or resize a widget, pages move normally. Reduce Motion disables the 3D effects. Removing this package does not delete your Home layout.

Inspired by Barrel by Aaron Ash and Cylinder by Reed Weichler. Re-created from scratch for Folio; none of their tweak code is included.

items: Cube, Inside Cube, Carousel and Stack
Optional add-on effects such as Tilt

blocks.notes: Requires Folio 0.7.0 or newer for this independently updated package. The effect renderer itself ships with Folio.

entries.notes: Flipbook enters the Folio Community Tweaks source as a separately updateable package. The effect renderer and built-in styles are unchanged.
Flipbook shipped in Folio's built-in Market source.
